profile.name: Connor
profile.goal: Operate Next Bar as a technically informed CTO who can approve, detect, and recover consequential software changes

nodes.name: Systems and environments
nodes.mastery_test: Unaided, trace an iPhone request through Vercel and Supabase and correctly classify Production, Staging, Preview, public keys, and secrets after a delayed review
nodes.proof: Next Bar architecture and environment diagram

nodes.name: Safe software delivery
nodes.mastery_test: Given a database-changing release, produce a correct staged deployment, compatibility, verification, and rollback plan without notes
nodes.proof: Rehearsed Next Bar release and rollback runbook

nodes.name: Data, security, and privacy
nodes.mastery_test: Threat-model a feature and identify its authorization, secret, privacy, retention, and deletion controls
nodes.proof: Reviewed Next Bar data map and security risk register

nodes.name: Reliability and incidents
nodes.mastery_test: Lead a simulated Production incident from detection through mitigation, recovery, communication, and postmortem

nodes.name: Scale and economics
nodes.mastery_test: Estimate 10x usage impact, identify the first bottleneck, and set a justified quota or budget control
nodes.proof: Next Bar capacity and unit-cost model

nodes.name: Technical leadership
nodes.mastery_test: Make and document a go, defer, delegate, or stop decision for a consequential feature using evidence and explicit tradeoffs
nodes.proof: Three reviewed architecture or product decision records

errors: Initially omitted the Vercel API route as the trusted middle layer
Confused local secret storage with the system allowed to use the Production key
Initially reversed the rollback compatibility direction
Verification plan did not explicitly test the old application against the migrated schema
sessions.notes: Passed additive-versus-destructive migration practice. Credential-boundary transfer, delayed review, and architecture artifact remain.
